key_insight: AbsorbEvo turns natural-language absorber performance goals into autonomous design iterations that combine LLM reasoning, physics-aware ranking, and full-wave verification.
engineering_relevance: It can substantially speed up microwave absorber inverse design by reducing expert manual tuning while still filtering candidates through physical simulation and validity checks.
method: LLM proposes parameter-update directions and magnitudes from the task objective and search history.
A low-cost predictive model ranks candidates as a physics prior before expensive full-wave simulation.
Successful results are converted into reusable textual skills, which are validated before transfer to new tasks.
evidence_signal: On held-out AbsorbBench-36 tasks under identical proposal budgets, AbsorbEvo achieved 79.17% task success and 0.7816 mean best coverage, outperforming a generic agent and random search.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of the predictive prior and validity checks, so poor surrogate accuracy or simulation constraints could limit reliability on new absorber families.
paper_title: AbsorbEvo: An Agentic Framework for Autonomous Inverse Design of Microwave Absorbers
